Businessman loses Rs 40 lakh and SUV to a 'Baba' in Raipur

A businessman from Indore traveled to Raipur seeking to uncover the cause of his brother's death. He reportedly fell victim to a fraudulent spiritual healer, a 'Baba', who allegedly took Rs 40 lakh and a luxury SUV from him. The 'Baba' is now absconding.
